payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Quinn planning proposal: to avoid self-overlap and still maximize soft overlaps, I suggest one representative meeting per time block. Tentative path for me: early lunch [2,4) in one of the lunch meetings (m014 or m003), then one activity [4,6) (prefer m007 Music [4,7) but I’d attend [4,6) or m011 Swimming [3,6) as [4,6)), then m009 Gaming [7,9), m010 Music [8,11) likely skip or only [9,11) conflicts with m009 at slot 8, and late block choose either m008 Gaming [11,14) or m001 Music [11,15), not both. If others can align on common representatives per block, we all gain. My preference: lunch [2,4), music/swim [4,6), gaming [7,9), gaming [11,14). Thoughts?

Riley proposal (planning iter 1): agree with choosing one representative meeting per overlapping block to avoid self-overlap penalties. My suggested path: m014 Lunch [2,4) (larger participant set than m003), then m007 Music [4,6) OR m016 Art [4,6) but I slightly prefer m007 since Quinn already mentioned it, then m009 Gaming [7,9), then late block choose exactly one of m008 Gaming [11,14) or m001 Music [11,15); I prefer m008 [11,14) because shorter and likely easier to coordinate. I will likely skip m013/m005/m011/m002 to avoid overlap unless group strongly prefers a different representative. If others can align on m014, m007, m009, m008, that seems clean.

Jordan planning iter 1: I support consolidating onto one meeting per overlapping block to avoid self-overlap penalties. For my meetings, a clean path is m014 Lunch [2,4), then m007 Music [4,6) (or equivalently attend m007 within its window as [4,6)), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m008 Gaming [11,14). I would skip overlapping alternatives m015/m013/m005/m016/m002/m004/m011/m006/m012/m010/m001 unless group coordination shifts. Reasoning: these chosen meetings have broad participation and match Quinn/Riley proposals, maximizing likely overlap. If others prefer art/swim instead of m007 for 4-6, please say so soon; otherwise I’ll plan around m014, m007, m009, m008.

Avery planning iter 1: I support the emerging no-overlap path on my meetings. For blocks I can attend, my preference is m014 Lunch [2,4), then m007 Music [4,6) (using interval [4,6) inside its window), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m008 Gaming [11,14). This matches Quinn/Riley/Jordan and avoids overlap penalties from m013/m015/m003/m005/m002/m004/m011/m006/m010/m001. If the group wants an even earlier lunch option m015 [1,3) or longer late music m001 [11,15), I can adapt, but default plan is m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14).

Taylor planning iter 1: I support the emerging coordinated path to avoid overlap penalties. For my meetings, my preferred schedule is m014 Lunch [2,4), then m007 Music [4,6) (attending within its window), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m008 Gaming [11,14). I would skip overlapping alternatives m015/m013/m005/m016/m002/m004/m011/m006/m012/m010/m001 unless the group shifts. This matches the broad-consensus representatives and should maximize soft overlap with many participants. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese planning iter 1: I support the consensus path for my meetings to avoid self-overlap penalties. My tentative plan is m014 Lunch [2,4), then m007 Music [4,6) (attending within its window), then m009 Gaming [7,9), and for the late block I can attend m001 Music [11,15) since that is my available meeting there. I plan to skip overlapping alternatives m015/m003/m013/m016/m002/m011/m006/m012/m010 unless group coordination changes. If anyone who also has m001 prefers late music over m008 gaming, please align there; otherwise I’ll keep this as default for my set. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quinn planning iter 1 follow-up: strong consensus now seems to be m014 Lunch [2,4), m007 Music [4,6), m009 Gaming [7,9), and m008 Gaming [11,14) for those who have them. For my own meetings, I’m happy to commit to that path in execution and skip the overlapping alternatives (m015/m003/m013/m016/m002/m004/m011/m006/m012/m010/m001). Reese: since you don’t have m008, your m001 [11,15) still makes sense; others with both m001 and m008 may want to prefer m008 so we don’t split late-block attendance too much.

Riley planning iter 1 follow-up: I’m aligned with the apparent consensus and, barring objections, will execute m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14), skipping my overlapping alternatives m003/m005/m016/m002/m011/m013/m001. Note on late block: I’ll prefer m008 over m001 to keep the main group together there; Reese can still take m001 since m008 isn’t available to them.

Jordan planning update: I’m fully aligned with the consensus path and intend to execute m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14), skipping my other overlapping options. Reese’s m001 [11,15) seems fine since m008 isn’t available to them; for everyone else with both late options, I still prefer concentrating on m008 to keep overlap dense. Unless someone signals a change next iteration, this is my final plan.

Avery planning update: I’m fully aligned with the consensus path and treat it as my final intended execution unless someone objects next iteration. For my meetings: attend m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14); skip m015/m003/m013/m005/m002/m004/m011/m006/m010/m001 to avoid self-overlap. This keeps me coordinated with Quinn/Riley/Jordan/Taylor and should maximize soft overlap.

Reese planning update: I’m aligned with the consensus execution path for my available meetings: attend m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), and m001 [11,15) since I do not have m008. I’ll skip overlapping alternatives m015/m003/m013/m016/m002/m011/m006/m012/m010. If any of Quinn/Avery/Riley/Taylor/Jordan also choose to attend m001 at all after m008, note there is no overlap with m008 at [11,14) only if they switch entirely; otherwise I expect to be solo/with any late-music switchers there. Unless objections arise, treat this as my final plan. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quinn planning confirmation: I’m locked on the consensus path for execution unless something changes next iteration. For my meetings I plan attend m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14), and skip m015/m003/m013/m016/m002/m004/m011/m006/m012/m010/m001 to avoid self-overlap penalties. This should keep me aligned with Avery/Jordan/Riley/Taylor on all shared blocks; Reese can still take m001 [11,15) as their late-block option. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Riley planning confirmation: no objections from me. For execution I intend to attend m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), and m008 [11,14), and skip m003/m005/m016/m002/m011/m013/m001 to avoid self-overlap. This matches the consensus path and keeps me aligned with Avery/Jordan/Quinn/Taylor; Reese can remain on m001 [11,15) for the late block. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan final planning confirmation: no change from consensus. I intend to execute m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14), and skip all my other meetings to avoid self-overlap penalties and keep overlap concentrated with Avery/Quinn/Riley/Taylor. Reese’s separate late-block m001 [11,15) still makes sense since they lack m008. Unless any issue arises, consider this locked for execution.

Avery final planning confirmation: no change from consensus. I’m locked for execution on m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14), and will skip m015/m003/m013/m005/m002/m004/m011/m006/m010/m001 to avoid self-overlap penalties. This keeps me aligned with Quinn/Jordan/Riley/Taylor; Reese remains sensibly on m001 [11,15) for the late block. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese planning confirmation: no change from my prior update. I’m locked for execution on m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), and m001 [11,15); I will skip m015/m003/m013/m016/m002/m011/m006/m012/m010 to avoid self-overlap. This keeps me aligned with the group on the first three blocks, and m001 remains my sensible late-block choice since I do not have m008. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan planning ack: no further changes from me. I remain locked on m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m008 [11,14), skipping all other meetings to avoid self-overlap and keep overlap concentrated. This should align with Avery/Quinn/Riley/Taylor; Reese on m001 [11,15) still looks like the best available late option for them. Ready for execution next phase.

Reese final planning note: still locked on m014 [2,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), and m001 [11,15), skipping m015/m003/m013/m016/m002/m011/m006/m012/m010. This matches consensus on the first three blocks and avoids all self-overlap; late block remains m001 for me since I lack m008. Ready for execution.
